why: Owner ruling 2026-11-02: Lands in performance-optimization, references/vetting.md, into `resolved-no-difference`. Upstream: SKILL.md:25.
modification: Into `resolved-no-difference`. Replaces the raw-variation test, because run spread is not the uncertainty of the estimated difference: the verdict rests on an interval for the reported difference against a margin chosen before running. subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/hillclimb.md
why: Final critic delta D1 and D2. A snapshot now requires end of stream and a zero exit after the last expected record, so a filter adding bytes to the last file refuses. undo and replay prove the result on a temporary index before the real apply, so a foreign edit or attributes arriving after the end snapshot refuse with nothing changed; the proof also covers the recorded index tree. patch refuses any change to a .gitattributes, since Git reads attributes while applying. A refusal from the verify after a real apply exits 1, so exit 2 keeps meaning nothing changed. Attributes from outside a snapshot changing during a climb stay a stated limit, surfacing as exit 1.
